# Data and third-party code

* **Synthetic experiments**: all images are generated by `src/gen2.py` and `src/data_utils.py` from a seed; nothing to download.
* **UAV-VisLoc** (real-data check): Xu et al., "UAV-VisLoc: A Large-scale Dataset for UAV Visual Localization", arXiv:2405.11936. The dataset
  repository states no licence, so **it is not redistributed here and its images must not be added to this repository**. Download flight 03 from
  the dataset authors (https://github.com/IntelliSensing/UAV-VisLoc), reduce it with a script of your own choosing to a satellite image of at most
  4500 px and about 40 drone frames, and set `VISLOC_DIR` (default `data/visloc_03_subset/`, containing `meta.json` and the images, see `real/common.py`).
* **SuperPoint + SuperGlue** are not bundled. They are released by Magic Leap under an academic, non-commercial licence.
  Clone https://github.com/magicleap/SuperGluePretrainedNetwork next to this folder (or set `SUPERGLUE_PATH`).
* The trial-level results (`results_v2/`, `results_real/`) are produced by this code and are included.
